analysis.overall: You had a strong day overall with 91% time in range and a super smooth night, though a late-morning meal right after a site change caused a sharp spike and fast drop.

events.title: Afternoon meal rise
events.description: A 30g carb snack bumped glucose up to 180 mg/dL, but insulin handled it well and brought you back under 120 mg/dL within two hours.

events.title: Evening dip and rebound
events.description: A brief low of 68 mg/dL led to a rebound spike up to 199 mg/dL, requiring several small correction doses over the next hour to level off.

events.title: Smooth overnight cruise
events.description: Your levels stayed remarkably steady between 75 and 110 mg/dL all night, giving you a completely peaceful sleep window.

events.title: Post-site change meal spike
events.description: Eating 50g of carbs shortly after a site change triggered a rapid climb up to a peak of 259 mg/dL.

events.title: Rapid drop back to range
events.description: Multiple correction boluses kicked in together, plunging glucose from 259 mg/dL straight back down to a steady 97 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for rapid drops when correcting meal spikes right after a site change, as insulin absorption can sometimes catch up all at once.
